meta.address_policy: Service-area business. Schema and contact page show Woodbridge, VA and the service area, not the street address (copy decision batch-2).

blue.note: Royal blue. Passes AA and AAA both ways. This is the brand color.

primary.note: Fails AA as text and as a button fill under white text. Not the logo blue. Drop it.

navy.note: Usable as a dark surface candidate but derive from the logo blue instead.

text_alt.role: body text seen in page CSS

legacy_web.note: Three Google font families loaded at every weight 100 to 900 italic. Font sprawl. Inter is on the Surge kill list unless the brand kit specifies it; it does not.

logo_wordmark.family: Unidentified wide bold geometric grotesque, uppercase, slightly extended. Outlines live in the PDF logo files.
logo_wordmark.note: Direction boards should either harmonize with this (wide grotesque heading face) or deliberately contrast it (condensed or slab). Do not pick a face that is almost-but-not-quite the wordmark.

logos.legacy_site_logo: https://rcallexteriors.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/10/Recurso-2@4x.png (776x315, same mark, white wordmark on transparent)
logos.svg_exports: Branding/logos/*.svg exported from rc-all-exteriors-logo-digital-rgb.pdf on 2026-10-05: full-color, white, black, blue-mark-white-text, icon-blue. Fills normalized to #0F2ACE and #303030.

heading.css: font-family: Archivo; font-stretch: 125%; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.02; letter-spacing: -0.015em

flags: contrast_issue: legacy primary #00A2FD is 2.77:1 on white. Legacy body text #949494 is 3.03:1. Both fail AA.
font_sprawl: Inter, IBM Plex Sans and Roboto all loaded, every weight. Inter is the de facto brand font by default, not by decision.
body_below_floor: legacy body is 16px / 1.4. Surge floor is 18px / 1.6.
missing_meta: no meta description on the homepage.
no_schema: zero JSON-LD on the site. No LocalBusiness, no RoofingContractor.
no_nap_on_homepage: address appears only in the roof-replacement page footer region. Footer says 'Serving the metropolitan area (DC, MD, VA)' with no street address.

invented_stats: About page shows '97% Reputation', '87% Value of Money', '92% Comprehensive Solutions', '95% Customer Services' and broken counters reading '0 YEAR OF EXPERIENCES' and '0 Completed Project'. None of this carries over.
stock_photography: at least one stock image (white-gutter-guard-system... and qtq80-...). Real photos exist (IMG_*.jpg) and should be collected from Ricardo at full resolution.
class_a_claim: 'CLASS A CONTRACTOR' appears as a heading. Need the Virginia DPOR licence number before it goes in the footer or schema.
tenure_resolved: founded 2025 per Mario (Sept 22). Old-site 2015 claim dropped. Copy leads with reviews, licence, warranty, never years.
recommendations: Brand color is the logo blue #0F2ACE, not the site's #00A2FD. Build the palette from #0F2ACE and #303030.
Derive accent-hover (#0B21A6 range) and accent-tint (#EEF0FC range) from #0F2ACE. White on #0F2ACE already passes, so no accent-btn derivation is needed.
Dark surface candidate: a near-black blue in the #0A1030 to #0D1427 range so dark sections feel like the brand rather than generic black.

Typography is fully open. Run the three-direction exercise. The wordmark is wide and geometric, so Direction C (wide grotesque) will harmonize and Direction A (condensed) will contrast. Both are valid. Avoid anything that looks like a near-miss of the wordmark face.
Collect 10 to 15 real job photos from Ricardo (roof tear-off, finished roofs, crew, truck) before the direction boards. The IMG_* files on the current site are a start but are compressed.
